description: This file defines the internal server logic for the AgentField control plane, including server setup, route configuration, health checks, gRPC service implementation, and initialization of DID and VC services. It sets up API endpoints, static UI serving, health monitoring, and other core server functionalities.

classes.name: AgentFieldServer
classes.description: Represents the core server managing the control plane, including API routes, gRPC server, health checks, and service initializations.

methods.name: NewAgentFieldServer
methods.description: Constructor function that initializes the server with configuration, dependencies, and core services, including DID/VC services if enabled.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the server, including setting up routes, starting background services, and listening on configured ports.

methods.name: startAdminGRPCServer
methods.description: Initializes and runs the admin gRPC server for internal communication.

methods.name: ListReasoners
methods.description: Provides a gRPC endpoint to list all registered reasoners across agent nodes.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down server services, including gRPC, health monitoring, background tasks, and HTTP server.

methods.name: unregisterAgentFromMonitoring
methods.description: HTTP handler to unregister an agent from health monitoring.

methods.name: healthCheckHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler to perform a comprehensive health check of sub-systems for container orchestration health reporting.

methods.name: checkStorageHealth
methods.description: Performs a health check specific to storage backend responsiveness.

methods.name: checkCacheHealth
methods.description: Performs a health check on the cache subsystem responsiveness.

methods.name: setupRoutes
methods.description: Configures all API endpoints, static UI serving, health checks, metrics, and fallback routes.

methods.name: generateAgentFieldServerID
methods.description: Creates a deterministic unique ID for the server based on its installation path.
